reading.title: A Day at the Lake
reading.text: Last Saturday Bobur wanted to go to the lake with his friends. First he checked the weather on his phone. The forecast said it would be warm in the morning, but changeable in the afternoon. The boys decided to go early, weather permitting. At the lake the sun was shining, so they swam and played football. At three o'clock dark clouds appeared and the wind became cold. They quickly packed their bags and took the bus home before the rain started.
